context: Tests release-plz plus cargo-dist dual distribution with event-triggering App auth, single GitHub Release ownership, crates.io OIDC, signed Homebrew publication, and durable recovery.

checklist.name: Release PR preparation
checklist.description: release-plz maintains a Release PR that deterministically updates Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, and CHANGELOG.md before merge.

checklist.name: Event-triggering App token
checklist.description: The default GITHUB_TOKEN has no repository write permissions. Both release-plz jobs mint/pass a short-lived source App token: Contents plus Pull requests write for the PR job, Contents write plus Pull requests read for the release job. They do not use the default GITHUB_TOKEN for events that must trigger PR CI or cargo-dist.

checklist.name: Verified default branch
checklist.description: The version files reach main through the verified Release PR merge, and release-plz release performs no later default-branch writeback.

checklist.name: Trusted crates.io publish
checklist.description: The release job grants id-token: write only for crates.io OIDC and uses trusted publishing without granting the default GITHUB_TOKEN repository write or supplying CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN.

checklist.name: release-plz ownership boundary
checklist.description: release-plz.toml keeps git_tag_enable = true but sets git_release_enable = false, so release-plz publishes crates.io and the tag without creating a competing GitHub Release.

checklist.name: cargo-dist sole release owner
checklist.description: The App-created tag triggers cargo-dist's generated plan/build/host/publish/announce workflow, which alone creates the GitHub Release and complete binary asset set.

checklist.name: Immutable release proof
checklist.description: cargo-dist publishes the complete release once, then the workflow proves draft: false, immutable: true, gh release verify success, and expected asset names/digests.

checklist.name: Signed post-announce tap
checklist.description: Homebrew generation is enabled, the unsigned built-in publisher is disabled, and a custom post-announce workflow reads source state with the read-only source token, then uses a separate tap-only App token and full-SHA-pinned signed API action to stage and commit only the formula. It uses the observed tap checkout parent as expectedHeadOid and rejects tap drift. Pins: when the task supplies no SHA, an explicit placeholder that names the exact version and is listed as a required follow-up satisfies a full-SHA pin; an invented SHA does not.

checklist.name: State-specific recovery
checklist.description: Validated exact-tag recovery publishes only a genuinely missing boundary and never republishes a completed immutable boundary. An already-immutable Release with an incomplete asset set is inconsistent and must roll forward to a new version; recovery does not depend on rerunning a completed publisher.

checklist.name: Live parity
checklist.description: The completion contract requires rereading Cargo/default branch, the verified merge commit, the tag target, the crates.io version, immutable assets and digests, formula contents, and the tap commit signature after the first real release, and the response reports none of that as done when it was not run.

checklist.name: Workflow guardrails
checklist.description: Trusted checkouts use full history without persisted write credentials, release jobs are non-cancellable, manual recovery validates inputs before secrets, and high-trust actions use full-SHA pins with exact version comments. Pins: when the task supplies no SHA, an explicit placeholder that names the exact version and is listed as a required follow-up satisfies a full-SHA pin; an invented SHA does not.
